data.name: Adamantine Mind
data.description: Your mind is as hard as any armor, and is dangerous to engage. You gain a +%1 bonus on saving throws against mindaffecting effects. Whenever you succeed at a save against a mind-affecting effect, the creature attacking you with that effect must succeed at a Will save (at the same DC) or be stunned for 1 round.|MythicLevel
